scientific_integrity: The limiting risks and polynomial phase classification are proved analytically and supplemented by exact arithmetic checks. Prior literature already establishes some failures of universal random-reshuffling superiority; this result claims the exact two-root phase diagram, not the mere existence of a failure.
scientific_limitations: The result does not cover finite-epoch ordering, averaged iterates, high-dimensional or nonquadratic losses, unequal sampling weights, changing stepsizes or unstable sampling regimes. Decimal thresholds approximate exact algebraic constants. Specialist publication-priority uncertainty remains.
scientific_scope: Exact stable-stepsize, stationary last-iterate expected loss for random reshuffling versus independent sampling on two scalar strictly convex quadratic summands with opposite gradients at their mean minimizer.
title: Sharp reentrant stationary-risk frontier for two-component random reshuffling
